$comment: Root .env vars NO provider set owns — those come straight from provider-sets.json's own credentials and need no separate declaration. Each of these is scoped to one FEATURE, never universally required: a project using none of these features needs none of them filled in. install.sh's generated .env.example reads this file; a var added here needs no installer edit.

vars.name: JIRA_EMAIL
vars.feature: Jira ticket ingestion (a project with EPAM_PROJECT set)

vars.name: JIRA_TOKEN
vars.feature: Jira ticket ingestion (a project with EPAM_PROJECT set)

vars.name: LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY
vars.feature: replay (--replay on / EPAM_REPLAY=on) — already checked separately by the installer's own Replay step

vars.name: LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY
vars.feature: replay (--replay on / EPAM_REPLAY=on) — already checked separately by the installer's own Replay step

vars.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
vars.feature: GitHub-hosted codelines via the copilot provider (src/providers/copilot/CopilotProvider.ts)
